description: EXAMPLE seed list. Copy to data/watchlist.json and fill with YOUR OWN niche accounts, or point $WATCHLIST at any JSON of this shape. Used as a fallback when the reference account has no public following list, and as a seed for scripts/find-creators.py.
how_to_build: Open a big living account in your niche, walk its 'similar profiles' block, keep every account that actually posts reels on your topic. Aim for ~100 before you automate anything.

accounts.biography: why this account is a reference for your niche
